about.title: Architecting AI systems that earn trust.
paragraphs: I've spent **20+ years across AI-enabled analytics, payments and enterprise security**, building for both **B2B enterprise and B2C consumer** markets. A hands-on cloud engineering and systems-architecture background lets me evaluate platform trade-offs and win CXO-level buy-in, not just spec features.

My career started in **test and quality**: risk-based test frameworks, automated execution and API-level verification. That shows up today in how I run **AI evaluation, success metrics and production monitoring**: golden datasets, guardrails and pass/fail thresholds before anything goes GA.

Today I'm **Director of Product Management at Qualys**, leading a team of 3 PMs that took its Agentic AI security platform to general availability. We expose agents through MCP, CLI and Slack / Teams, so engineers can use them without opening a dashboard. I also write about Agentic AI and enterprise product strategy, and publish my AI builds on GitHub.

approach.title: The AI PM paradigm I actually run.
approach.subtitle: Industry default starts with the model. I start with the customer's pain and put trust in the pipeline.

contrast.mine: Starts with customer pain, and picks ML or rules where they are cheaper

contrast.default: Treats trust as a policy document
contrast.mine: Engineers compliance and redaction into the pipeline
Invents domain-specific trust and safety measures
Builds closed-loop action engines and MCP tool rails
Prioritizes by severity and tail-risk impact

steps.title: Ideate & Frame
steps.text: Anchor on the customer's real pain.

steps.title: Discover & Validate
steps.text: Test the pain; size impact & fit.

steps.title: Decide on AI
steps.text: LLM, classic ML or governance, sized to the problem.

steps.title: Architect & Build
steps.text: Agents, RAG, MCP + a trust layer.

approach.throughline: **The through-line:** I start from the customer's problem and use AI only where it beats a simpler option.

principles.title: Judgment over hype
principles.text: LLMs where reasoning matters, classic ML where it's cheaper, governance where users need to trust the output before they adopt it.

principles.title: Value-obsessed
principles.text: Every product ties to business value (cost, risk, new channels) and user value (their own tools, hours-to-minutes, trust built in).

principles.title: Ship, don't slideware
principles.text: Every product has a working, zero-install way to see it run. Metrics that are modelled targets are labelled as such.

experience.title: Experience
experience.subtitle: The Director seat is eight months. The four and a half years at BP are the depth behind it. Scope is marked direct, matrix, or part-time.

roles.title: Director of Product Management
roles.summary: Leading 3 PMs taking the Agentic AI security suite from pilots to general availability: multi-agent orchestration, tool use and evaluation.
bullets: Lead and coach a team of **3 Product Managers** owning vision and roadmap for the Agentic AI security platform, identifying high-value AI use cases and translating multi-agent and LLM capabilities into a GTM strategy.

Ran **15+ enterprise pilots** in the first two quarters against defined success criteria (agentic flow correctness, result accuracy); CXO-level evangelism converted **40%** into paid proof-of-concepts, building a **$1.5M POC pipeline**.
Exposed agentic capabilities through API-first, tool-based surfaces (**Model Context Protocol (MCP), CLI and Slack / Microsoft Teams**), so developers use security agents in their own workflows.
Designed agent action interfaces and tool integrations so agents take real actions, such as exploit validation and remediation orchestration, instead of only answering in a chat.

Built the requirements, evaluation and success metrics framework for multi-agent orchestration (accuracy criteria, response-safety guardrails and pass/fail thresholds) for features that shipped in the **GA release**.

Prioritise the roadmap on strategic fit, user value and business value, refined with **Cost of Delay**; partner with Engineering, Platform, UX and Data Science, cutting feature scoping cycle time by **15%**.
Co-design go-to-market with Sales and Marketing, run **quarterly roadmap reviews** with leadership and Sales, and lead customer calls on product capabilities and fitment.

roles.title: Fractional CPO
roles.org: AI Product & Strategy · Part-time advisory · B2B & B2C · Remote
roles.summary: Part-time. Shipped a B2C healthtech conversational AI chatbot alongside B2B AI advisory, including CropGuard for ambient crop insurance.
bullets: Defined product strategy for a consumer healthtech **conversational AI chatbot** answering users' medical queries in real time, owning the **query-accuracy and response-safety evaluation framework** from discovery through launch.

Served as Fractional CPO for early-stage AI founders, identifying high-value AI use cases and defining roadmaps and personas that took **3+ 0-to-1 concepts** from raw idea to market-ready SaaS in under 4 months each.
Architected a computer-vision MVP for a Digital Wellness startup; rapid A/B loops lifted user engagement by **24%** within 6 weeks of launch.
Built **CropGuard**: ambient WhatsApp and voice crop insurance for Indian farmers — parametric drought claims, multilingual channels, and geo-verified field evidence on Express, React and Postgres.

Advised a B2B AgriTech & Crop Insurance platform on the LLM and RAG architecture behind its self-service farmer query product, cutting cost per query by **35%** while scaling to **50K+** queries monthly.
Designed responsible AI compliance protocols aligned to NIST and the EU AI Act, institutionalising a “Trust by Design” framework across 2 client engagements.

roles.title: Principal Product Manager

bullets: Owned GenAI and cloud security product strategy across 15+ business units, aligning Security, Engineering, Platform and Compliance stakeholders on a shared roadmap.

**AI Defense Ecosystem:** established standardised AI eval harnesses and end-to-end auditability on a unified Agentic AI trust platform (Prevent, Protect, Detect & Respond), securing **$2M+** in C-suite investment and mitigating **$10M+** risk exposure.

**AI Policy Foundry:** cut policy review cycles from 1–3 weeks to **30 minutes** with 95%+ policy accuracy and **$2.4M** annual savings, using a 5-agent GPT-4 product with full clause-level auditability.
**AI SOC Portal:** reduced Mean Time to Triage by **more than 60%** and executive reporting overhead by ~50%, sustaining an **85%+** analyst action rate (RAGAS groundedness above 0.90).

**AI-SPM:** delivered sub-second threat blocking and predictive drift and anomaly detection across 6 data quality dimensions, flagging issues before business impact and automating NIST & EU AI Act compliance evidence.

Led a 25-person product team without direct reporting lines, setting its vision, goals and priorities; built organisational AI capability through the corporate **AI Maturity Index**, accelerating cloud time-to-market by **20%**.
